title: Cyber Security Secure Port Access
content: Solutions 4: Cyber Security Secure Port Access. Astonishing Convenience. Unmatched Security. Step into the future of remote connectivity with our proprietary Secure Port Access technology — delivering the perfect combination of impenetrable security and effortless convenience. Once you experience it, you'll never want to connect any other way. Problem Statement Faced by Customer: Traditional remote access requires opening ports on the target server — a direct invitation for cyberattacks. Every open port increases your exposure, making your systems visible and vulnerable to malicious actors. Secure Port Access: Our advanced Secure Port Access solution eliminates this risk entirely. By enabling remote connections without opening any ports, your infrastructure remains invisible to potential attackers — securing your systems by design. Uncompromising Security - No open ports, no exposure. Our technology ensures remote access without public port disclosure, removing one of the most exploited vulnerabilities in cybersecurity. Exceptional Convenience - No global IP address required. Centrally manage multiple remote destinations with ease. Whether it's one site or an entire network, setup is simple, streamlined, and fast. Key Benefits Include: Zero exposed ports = zero attack surface. Centralized management of multiple remote endpoints. No dependency on global IP addresses. Simple, fast setup for immediate productivity. Secure. Simple. Smart. Our Secure Port Access solution isn't just secure — it's secure by design. Experience worry-free remote access without compromising on speed, convenience, or control.

content: Services 1: Robotic System Development. Partner with us to turn your robotics and IoT vision into a reality that transforms the way you work. IoT System Integration: Smart devices and sensors that connect your physical assets to powerful digital insights. AI-Driven Analytics: Turn real-time data into actionable decisions with predictive and prescriptive analytics. Seamless Connectivity: Ensure your devices, robots, and systems communicate securely and efficiently. End-to-End Solutions: From hardware design and prototyping to software development and cloud integration. Secure & Scalable Architecture: Future-proof systems built with security and scalability in mind.

title: Digitize Records
content: Services 2: AI Digitize Past Records & Documents - High-Speed AI Scanning & Character Recognition. Quickly convert hardcopy documents into a searchable digital archive. Centralize your document repository, reduce storage costs, and enable efficient data access with our digitization solution. Problem Statement Faced by Customer: Large volumes of paper-based records were consuming physical storage and required manual retrieval. High rental costs for archive storage. Delayed access to time-sensitive documents. Risk of physical degradation over time. End-to-End Document Management: We implemented a complete digitization pipeline with OCR and metadata tagging. Batch scanning and indexing. Cloud-based search and retrieval. Secure document lifecycle policies. Cost Saving: By going digital, the customer reduced ongoing paper form expenses and manual admin hours. Risk Mitigation: Digital records are encrypted, backed up, and access-controlled to meet regulatory standards. Steps include: Step 1 - Convert tonnes of hardcopy past records. Step 2 - High speed scanning to create digital copies. Step 3 - Cloud and on premise depositories to store digital data.

title: Manufacturing Operation
content: Services 3: Manufacturing Operation Leverage on Japanese Monotsukuri (物作り) know-hows Operational efficiency is vital, but when success means embracing economic diversification. Our solutions are aligned with Industry 4.0 and ESG pillars, empowering businesses to thrive across diverse sectors while promoting sustainable growth Problem Statement Faced by Customer Balancing operational efficiency with economic diversification poses a significant challenge for businesses. The need to optimize processes while adapting to diverse demands complicates strategic planning and resource allocation. Harnessing Japanese Monotsukuri (物作り) Innovative expertise in manufacturing to address manufacturing challenges. Improve Operational Efficiency By leveraging traditional Monotsukuri principles in modern processes. Cost Effective Solution Achieved through improving operational efficiency. Manufacturing Operation illustration Major Solutions Include Advance Planning & Scheduling (APS) APS is an integrated supply planning solution that covers the entire production planning area by unifying the capabilities of conventional production planning systems. Consists of 4 key modules: Master Production Schedule (MPS): Plan the production schedule and quantity. Capacity Requirements Planning (CRP): Plan equipment and human capacity required for manufacturing. Finite Capacity Scheduling (FCS): Plan the production sequence of products and parts. Material Requirements Planning (MRP): Plan the quantity of necessary materials and parts. Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS) CMMS flexibly adapts to a wide range of asset maintenance tasks — from scheduling to tracking equipment performance and ensuring uptime across operations. PLC IoT Devices and More Expand system capabilities with real-time data collection from IoT-connected PLC devices — enabling predictive maintenance, smarter insights, and process automation.
